exercises.why: **убе́жище** — asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter). Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ищ», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ищ).

exercises.q: He threw the cigarette butt on the ground.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **рубец** — scar, wake, cicatrice. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ец», meaning 5 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ец).
**отде́лка** — finishing, trimming, decoration work/finish. Source: Wiktionary, «-ка» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ка#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: оре́шник — (botany) hazel; убе́жище — asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter); сбо́рище — assemblage, gathering of people; оку́рок — cigarette butt, cigar butt.
